Explanation: The core value unit is a booked household service with a defined task, time and price, such as cleaning, furniture assembly or TV mounting.
Handy is an Angi brand that organizes direct service booking, matching, payment, trust tools and support while independent pros perform the work.
Handy has to turn a household need into a bookable job and connect it with a suitable local pro.
Reliable completed jobs can create repeat bookings, recurring cleaning relationships and platform fees.
Handy must maintain enough available pros while reducing no-shows, poor service, safety concerns and customer dissatisfaction.
Handy coordinates bookings, customer payments, pro payouts and platform trust/support fees for direct-booked services.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Book / Pay — The customer chooses a standardized service and time and pays through Handy for eligible direct-booked services. | → Consumer · Price / Match — Handy provides the upfront booking flow, confirms the appointment and matches the request with an available pro. | ← Provider · Skills / Time — Pros provide service skills, availability and the willingness to claim or accept local jobs. | → Provider · Jobs / Payout — Handy routes suitable jobs to pros and handles payment for direct-booked platform work. | ← Partner · ID / Checks — External trust providers support identity verification and background screening used in the pro approval process.

Explanation: Platform rules, cancellation policies, ratings, screening requirements and service guarantees govern participation.
Handy reaches customers through search, its app and website, and partner channels that can attach services to products or properties.
Handy structures services, prices bookings, matches pros, manages payments, supports appointments and handles customer issues.
Core resources include the pro network, booking software, pricing logic, ratings, service definitions, payments and customer data.
Customers are households, renters, landlords or businesses that need cleaning, assembly, repairs, installation or other local help.
Customers want to get a suitable local service completed without searching, calling and negotiating with many individual providers.
For many common tasks, the customer can select a time and see an upfront price before the job is booked.
Letting a stranger into a home creates trust concerns, and delays, cancellations or poor-quality work can disrupt the booking.
Customers choose a service and time and pay for eligible direct-booked services through the Handy platform.
Transaction Flows: → Owner · Book / Pay — The customer chooses a standardized service and time and pays through Handy for eligible direct-booked services. | ← Owner · Price / Match — Handy provides the upfront booking flow, confirms the appointment and matches the request with an available pro. | → Provider · Service / Rating — The pro performs the household service and the customer can communicate, review and rate the completed work.

Explanation: Customers select the type of job, timing and location; service availability and price depend on the market.
Customers use Handy’s website or app to browse services, book jobs, message a pro, manage appointments and rate work.
Customers describe the job, choose timing, prepare access, communicate with the pro and review the result.
Customers bring the physical place and problem to be solved, job details, schedule and payment method.
Independent cleaners, handymen, installers and other skilled service professionals perform the household work.
Pros want access to local paid jobs without having to find every customer and manage every payment themselves.
Pros can choose when to work and claim jobs that fit their schedule, skills and geography.
Travel time, cancellations, inconsistent demand, job complexity and customer ratings can reduce earnings.
Pros accept or claim suitable jobs and perform the agreed household service.
Transaction Flows: → Owner · Skills / Time — Pros provide service skills, availability and the willingness to claim or accept local jobs. | ← Owner · Jobs / Payout — Handy routes suitable jobs to pros and handles payment for direct-booked platform work. | ← Consumer · Service / Rating — The pro performs the household service and the customer can communicate, review and rate the completed work.

Explanation: Applicants need relevant paid experience, valid identification, applicable licensing and required screening.
Pros use Handy/Angi Services tools to review local jobs, see pricing, claim work and manage appointments.
Pros review job details, travel to the customer, perform the service, communicate and close the appointment.
Pros bring trade skills, time, transportation, tools, licenses where required and service experience.
External identity and background-check providers support the screening layer that helps Handy approve individual pros.
Trust providers verify identity credentials and search background records used in pro onboarding.
A larger service marketplace creates recurring demand for identity verification and screening services.
Background records can be incomplete or restricted, and screening cannot guarantee future behavior.
Jumio supports identity credential verification and Checkr performs background checks for individual professionals.
Transaction Flows: → Owner · ID / Checks — External trust providers support identity verification and background screening used in the pro approval process.

Explanation: Screening depth depends on available records, law, geography and the type of provider being onboarded.
Digital integrations connect Handy’s onboarding flow with third-party verification and screening systems.
Partners validate identity data, search available records and return screening results to support onboarding.
Key resources include identity-verification technology, databases, compliance processes and screening infrastructure.
